import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

source = Path('/tmp/f9-cri-transport-sol/tools/tool-devsync/feasibility/source-memory-relay')
original = (source / 'connected_fixture.py').read_text()
needle = "if kind != b'S' or status != b'0':"

    'status-kind': ("if status != b'0':", "('wrong-status-kind', {'outcome': 'complete'"),
}
receipts = []
for fault, (replacement, diagnostic) in faults.items():

        combined = invocation.stdout + invocation.stderr
        Path(f'/tmp/f9-connected-fault-{fault}.log').write_text(combined)
        assert invocation.returncode == 1 and diagnostic in combined, (fault, invocation.returncode, combined)
        receipts.append({'fault': fault, 'exit': invocation.returncode, 'diagnostic': diagnostic, 'readFrameRetained': True})
print(json.dumps(receipts))
